subject: Retention & Erasure Attestation — tenanted deletion walkthrough request
messages:
From: Emma Clarke <emma.clarke@atlanticbank.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: tenanted deletion walkthrough and attestation for SOC2 audit

Hi Vivek,

We're getting ready for our SOC 2 and ISO readiness review next month and the auditors have asked for a "tenanted deletion walkthrough" for a sample of customer tenants. Specifically they want: a clear narrative of how a deletion request flows from API -> queue -> erasure job, the TTL/archival breakpoints, examples of exported deletion logs for three sample tenants (timestamps and assertion of successful erasure), and any attestation language you can provide.

Can you share a short walkthrough and artifacts for Atlantic Bank's sample tenant (tenant-id: ab-1123)? We'd like to attach it to our control testing packet by 2026-09-22. If a live call helps, we're available next week.

Thanks,
Emma Clarke
Senior Compliance Manager
Atlantic Bank — InfoSec

Attachment: audit-ask-2026Q3.pdf (stub)
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Clarke <emma.clarke@atlanticbank.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 10:05:30 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: tenanted deletion walkthrough and attestation for SOC2 audit

Emma —

Thanks for the clear ask and the timeline. We can provide: (1) a written walkthrough describing the request flow, (2) a CSV export of the deletion job logs for tenant ab-1123 and two additional sample tenants, (3) the TTL/archival policy mapping for the regions that handled those tenants, and (4) our standard attestation statement signed by our Compliance lead.

I will coordinate artifacts and aim to get the package to you by EOD 2026-09-18 so you have time to review before your control packet deadline. If you would like a short 30-min walkthrough call after you review, happy to schedule next Tuesday.

Looping in Monica and Priyom to pull the logs, TTL maps, and the attestation draft. Monica — can you prepare the CSVs and pinpoint the earliest/last deletion events? Priyom — please include the retention mapping image and a short bulleted narrative of the erasure job steps (queue names, background worker names, and verification checks).

Vivek
VP, Compliance Operations
Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: none
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 11:20:45 -0700
Subject: ACTION: collate deletion artifacts for Atlantic Bank (ab-1123)

Team —

Summary of what Emma needs (deadline EOD):
- CSV of deletion job logs for three tenants: ab-1123, ab-1147, ab-1188. Include job_id, started_at, completed_at, objects_deleted_count, verification_hash, operator_id.
- TTL / archival mapping screenshot that shows the breakpoints (hot cache TTL, KV-cache TTL, cold storage retention).
- Short narrative (3-5 bullets) describing the erasure workflow: API call -> deletion queue (delete-tenant-queue) -> erasure worker shard -> secondary verification (checksum+scan) -> tombstone and metadata purge -> archival manifest update.
- A single-page attestation draft (we'll sign later).

Monica: please pull the logs and sanitize PII where required. Priyom: export the TTL diagram and write the narrative. Attach file stubs with filenames below when done.

Attachments expected (names to use in the package):
- tenant_deletion_log_202607-202608.csv
- tenant_deletion_log_ab-1147_202607.csv
- tenant_deletion_log_ab-1188_202608.csv
- erasure-policy-summary-V2.pdf
- kv-cache-ttl-map.png

Thanks — ping me if any of these are delayed.

Vivek

Emma —

We pulled together the requested package for tenant ab-1123 and two comparison tenants. Links and attachments are below; I summarized the key verification points up front to save the auditors' time.

Summary (top-level):
- Deletion confirmed: For ab-1123, deletion job id DJ-20260715-983 completed at 2026-07-15T03:14:22Z; verification hash matched the post-erasure scan; objects_deleted_count = 12,413.
- Chain of custody: request originated via the API key associated to tenant admin, entered delete-tenant-queue, was processed by erasure-worker-shard-07, and passed secondary checksum verification before tombstone purge.
- Retention mapping: hot cache TTL = 48 hours, KV-cache TTL = 7 days, cold storage retention policy shows archival retention window of 90 days before final purging; all three sample tenants followed the same lifecycle.
- Attestation: see attached draft; Redwood Compliance will provide a signed attestation on company letterhead once you confirm the package matches your control scope.

Attachments (included):
- tenant_deletion_log_202607-202608.csv (CSV export — sanitized)
- erasure-policy-summary-V2.pdf (policy mapping and attestation draft)
- kv-cache-ttl-map.png (diagram)

Drive link with original logs and manifests: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/atlanticbank/retention-artifacts/ (read-only).

If you'd like a quick 20-minute walkthrough, I'm available Mon 09/21 10:00-12:00 PDT or Tue 09/22 14:00-16:00 PDT. Please confirm preferred slot and I'll send a calendar invite.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Compliance Operations
Redwood Inference
